tools.name: ad-fraud_bot-detect
tools.description: Look for automation indicators in caller-supplied HTTP and browser signals. An IP address is ignored. A User-Agent token is a string match, not proof of a bot. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/bot-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_browser-integrity-check
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied browser properties for contradictions. The User-Agent is not verified, and a timezone offset is not a location. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/browser-integrity-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_device-consistency-check
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied device type, OS, model, screen, and architecture. No device identity is looked up. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/device-consistency-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_click-timing-analyze
tools.description: Check caller-supplied click timestamps and dwell for impossible order or a fixed short gap. One fast click is a weak indicator, not a campaign pattern. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/click-timing-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_duplicate-click-detect
tools.description: Find repeated click ids, gclids, and fbclids in the supplied batch and optional history. Nothing is stored between calls. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/duplicate-click-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_click-velocity-analyze
tools.description: Count timestamped clicks inside a supplied window. A burst is a frequency calculation, not proof of automation. Clicks are not grouped by IP. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/click-velocity-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_referrer-integrity-check
tools.description: Compare a caller-supplied referrer, landing URL, and campaign source. URLs are not fetched. A family mismatch is a heuristic, not a verified referrer. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/referrer-integrity-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_click-fingerprint-analyze
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied canvas, WebGL, audio, and font hashes. Hashes are not computed here, and a match is not a device identity. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/click-fingerprint-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_conversion-fraud-detect
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied clicks and conversions for time order, campaign mismatch, and repeated ids. An unmatched conversion is a missing link, not proof the click never happened. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/conversion-fraud-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does n

tools.name: ad-fraud_campaign-anomaly-detect
tools.description: Find impossible ratios and, when at least eight rows have clicks and impressions, click-through-rate outliers. An outlier is a statistic, not a fraud verdict. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/campaign-anomaly-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_click-pattern-detect
tools.description: Look for identical timestamps, a fixed gap, or identical coordinates across a supplied click collection. Fewer than five usable clicks is insufficient. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/click-pattern-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: ad-fraud_click-risk-score
tools.description: Sum a documented weight for each supplied click attribute. Missing data adds no points. The score is not a probability of fraud. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ad-fraud/click-risk-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ad-fraud" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ad-fraud_browser-integrity-check, ad-fraud_device-consistency-check, ad-fraud_click-timing-analyze, ad-fraud_referrer-integrity-check · Private data: ad-fraud_bot-detect · Public sink: ad-fraud_bot-detect, ad-fraud_browser-integrity-check, ad-fraud_device-consistency-check, ad-fraud_click-timing-analyze, ad-fraud_duplicate-click-detect, ad-fraud_click-velocity-analyze, ad-fraud_referrer-integrity-check, ad-fraud_click-fingerprint-analyze, ad-fraud_conversion-fraud-detect, ad-fraud_campaign-anomaly-detect, ad-fraud_click-pattern-detect, ad-fraud_click-risk-score · Destructive: ad-fraud_bot-detect, ad-fraud_browser-integrity-check, ad-fraud_device-consistency-check, ad-fraud_click-timing-analyze, ad-fraud_duplicate-click-detect, ad-fraud_click-velocity-analyze, ad-fraud_referrer-integrity-check, ad-fraud_click-fingerprint-analyze, ad-fraud_conversion-fraud-detect, ad-fraud_campaign-anomaly-detect, ad-fraud_click-pattern-detect, ad-fraud_click-risk-score.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
